question: A screw gauge has a pitch of $0.5\ \text{mm}$ and 50 divisions on its circular scale. It has a positive zero error of 3 circular divisions. While measuring the diameter of a wire, the main scale reading is $1.5\ \text{mm}$ and the circular scale reading is 36 divisions. Find the corrected diameter of the wire in mm.
solution:
Least count $= \dfrac{\text{pitch}}{\text{number of circular divisions}} = \dfrac{0.5}{50} = 0.01\ \text{mm}$

Observed reading $= 1.5 + 36\times 0.01 = 1.86\ \text{mm}$

Zero error $= +3\times 0.01 = +0.03\ \text{mm}$, which is subtracted:
$$d = 1.86 - 0.03 = 1.83\ \text{mm}$$
